scenario: What is an SLA in IT support?

options.text: An agreed target for response and resolution times
A software license for the help desk tool
A list of approved hardware vendors for the company

explanation: SLAs set expectations, such as responding to critical tickets within 15 minutes.

scenario: Which ticket should be prioritized first?

options.text: Email is down for the whole company
A user wants a second monitor
A request to change a desktop wallpaper for the marketing team

explanation: Priority combines impact (how many affected) and urgency.

scenario: What should a technician record in a ticket after each customer interaction?

options.text: What was done, the result and next steps
Personal opinions about the customer and their technical skill

explanation: Good notes help the next technician and build the knowledge base.

scenario: Which KPI measures how often issues are solved during the first contact?

options.text: Number of tickets opened by the help desk each month

explanation: Other help desk KPIs include average handle time and customer satisfaction.

scenario: What's the first step in a problem-solving process?

options.text: Identify the problem by gathering information
Escalate the ticket to the network team immediately

explanation: Then establish a theory, test it, plan, implement, verify and document.

scenario: A technician can't solve an issue within their authority. What should they do?

options.text: Ask the user to search online and fix it themselves

explanation: Include all notes so the next tier doesn't repeat work.

scenario: Which describes active listening with a customer?

options.text: Paraphrasing their issue to confirm understanding
Typing unrelated notes while they explain the problem

explanation: Ask clarifying questions and avoid assumptions.

scenario: How should a technician manage a queue of tickets with different priorities?

options.text: Work highest priority first, within SLAs
Pick the easiest tickets first to improve personal statistics

explanation: Communicate with users whose tickets are waiting.

scenario: Why is a knowledge base useful for a help desk?

options.text: It stores solutions to common problems
It stores user passwords for faster account recovery

explanation: Writing articles from resolved tickets saves time later.

scenario: Which statement is the most professional way to explain a delay to a user?

options.text: "I've escalated this and will update you by 3 PM."
"This kind of thing happens all the time, so just wait."

explanation: Set clear expectations and follow through.

scenario: What should a technician do before closing a ticket?

options.text: Confirm with the user that the issue is resolved
Reset the user's password just in case something else breaks

explanation: Verify functionality, then document the resolution.

scenario: What does tier 1 support typically handle?

options.text: Writing custom software for the company's internal systems

explanation: Complex problems are escalated to tier 2 or 3.

scenario: A user is upset that their laptop is slow. What should the technician do first?

options.text: Stay calm and acknowledge their frustration
Transfer them without explanation to another department

explanation: Empathy helps de-escalate and gather information.

scenario: Which information is most useful in a new ticket?

options.text: Who, what device, what happened and when
Only the word "broken" in the description field

explanation: Include error messages and any recent changes.

scenario: What should you do before opening a desktop computer case?

options.text: Power it off, unplug it and use an ESD strap
Leave it running to watch the fans
Spray water inside to clean the dust out

explanation: ESD (electrostatic discharge) can damage components.

scenario: Which Windows tool quickly shows the computer's model, RAM and OS version?

options.text: Disk Cleanup utility for temporary files

explanation: Settings > System > About also shows key details.

scenario: Which port type is reversible and can carry data, video and power?

options.text: RJ-11 telephone jack on older modems

explanation: Thunderbolt 3 and 4 also use the USB-C connector.

scenario: Which video port carries both digital video and audio and is common on TVs?
explanation: DisplayPort is common on PC monitors.

scenario: A user wants their PC to handle more browser tabs at once. Which upgrade helps most?

options.text: Replace the keyboard with a mechanical one

explanation: Check the motherboard's supported memory type and capacity.

scenario: Which storage upgrade most improves boot and app load times?

options.text: Replacing an HDD with an SSD
Using a larger USB flash drive for apps

explanation: NVMe SSDs are faster than SATA SSDs.

scenario: A PC shuts down randomly and the case feels hot. What's the most likely cause?

options.text: Overheating from dust or a failed fan

options.note: Would cause network drops, not shutdowns.
Would not shut down the PC.

explanation: Clean dust with compressed air and check fans.

scenario: A computer beeps and shows nothing on screen at power-on. What is this usually?

options.text: A POST error, often memory or video
A sign that Windows Update is installing

explanation: Beep codes vary by firmware vendor.

scenario: Which component keeps the system clock running when the PC is unplugged?
explanation: A dead CMOS battery causes the clock to reset.

scenario: Which component must match the motherboard socket?
explanation: Examples include Intel LGA and AMD AM5 sockets.

scenario: A laptop's battery drains fast and the case is bulging. What should be done?

options.text: Stop using it and replace the battery safely
Press the case flat and continue using it

explanation: Swollen lithium-ion batteries are a fire hazard; recycle properly.

scenario: Which tool safely cleans dust from inside a computer?

options.text: A damp cloth with water on the motherboard

explanation: Hold fans still while blowing air so they don't overspin.

scenario: A monitor shows "No signal." What should be checked first?

options.text: The video cable and selected input

options.note: Windows would still show something at boot.

explanation: Make sure the cable is in the correct GPU port.

scenario: Which describes the difference between an internal and external storage device?

options.text: Internal is inside the case; external connects by cable
Internal drives can't store operating systems

explanation: External drives often use USB or Thunderbolt.

scenario: A printer prints faded pages. What's the most likely cause?

options.note: Usually garbles output rather than fading it.

explanation: Replace consumables and run a cleaning or calibration cycle.

scenario: What should a technician wear when handling components to prevent static damage?

options.text: Wool clothing for warmth in the server room

explanation: Work on an ESD mat when possible.

scenario: A user can't access a shared drive after changing departments. What's the likely cause?

options.text: Their group memberships don't include the share
Their DNS cache is out of date
options.note: Would affect name lookup for all shares.

options.text: Their computer needs a new IP address
options.note: They can still reach other resources.

explanation: Update group membership; permissions usually follow groups.

scenario: Which Windows command applies updated Group Policy settings immediately?
explanation: Users may need to sign out and back in for some policies.

scenario: Which Windows command maps a network share to drive letter Z?

options.text: tracert server to show the path

explanation: File Explorer's Map network drive does the same.

scenario: A user is locked out after too many wrong passwords. What should the help desk do?

options.text: Verify identity, then unlock or reset the account
Read the password back to them
Create a brand-new account with a different username

explanation: Always verify identity before resetting credentials.

scenario: A wireless mouse stops working. What should be checked first?

options.text: Batteries and the USB receiver connection

options.note: Rarely the first thing to check.

explanation: For Bluetooth devices, check pairing too.

scenario: A new USB printer isn't recognized. What should be done?

options.text: Try another port and install the driver
Replace the motherboard with a newer model

explanation: Check Device Manager for unknown devices.

scenario: A laptop shows connected to Wi-Fi but has no internet. What should be checked first?

options.text: Its IP address and default gateway

explanation: A 169.254.x.x address means DHCP failed.

scenario: Which command releases and renews a DHCP address on Windows?
explanation: ipconfig /flushdns clears the DNS cache.

scenario: A user can reach websites by IP address but not by name. What's the problem?

options.text: The Ethernet cable connection to the switch

options.note: They can reach IP addresses, so routing works.

explanation: Check the DNS server settings and try nslookup.

scenario: Which is the main difference between a LAN connection and a WLAN connection?

options.text: LAN uses cables; WLAN uses Wi-Fi
WLAN doesn't use IP addresses at all

explanation: Wired connections are usually more reliable.

scenario: A user's laptop connects to the wrong Wi-Fi network automatically. What should be done?

options.text: Forget the unwanted network in Wi-Fi settings
Reset the laptop to factory settings

explanation: Set the preferred network to connect automatically.

scenario: Which MFA issue is common when a user gets a new phone?

options.text: Their authenticator app must be set up again

options.note: Accounts are not tied to the phone.

options.text: Their laptop's IP address changes to a new subnet

explanation: Help desks verify identity before resetting MFA methods.

scenario: A user can open a file but can't save changes to it on a share. What's likely?

options.text: The file is too large to open

options.note: They can open the file over the network.

explanation: Check NTFS and share permissions.

scenario: Which directory service do many organizations use to manage users and computers?

options.text: Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID
A local spreadsheet stored on the help desk PC

explanation: Directory services centralize authentication and policy.

scenario: A Bluetooth headset won't connect to a laptop. What should be tried first?

options.text: Re-pair the device and check Bluetooth is on
Replace the laptop's display with a new panel

explanation: Remove the device from Bluetooth settings, then pair again.

scenario: Which command tests whether a PC can reach its default gateway?

options.text: ping followed by the gateway's IP
whoami to show the current user

explanation: If the gateway responds, test an internet address next.

scenario: A user's password reset worked, but their phone still prompts for the old password. What's needed?

options.text: Update the password on the phone's email account
Disable the user's account until the phone stops

explanation: Saved credentials on devices can also cause lockouts.

scenario: A Windows app is frozen. How can the user close it?

options.text: End the task in Task Manager
Delete the app's shortcut from the desktop

explanation: Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager.

scenario: A Windows update caused problems. Which feature can roll the system back without deleting files?

options.text: Reset this PC with Remove everything

explanation: You can also uninstall a specific update from Windows Update settings.

scenario: Which macOS app shows running processes and resource use?
explanation: Force Quit (Option+Command+Esc) closes frozen apps.

scenario: Which macOS feature backs up files automatically to an external drive?
explanation: Time Machine keeps hourly, daily and weekly backups.

scenario: A smartphone app keeps crashing. What should be tried first?

options.text: Force close and update the app
Replace the phone's battery and screen

explanation: Then try clearing its cache or reinstalling.

scenario: A phone's storage is full and apps won't update. What helps?

options.text: Remove unused apps and offload photos
Increase the screen brightness to maximum

explanation: Cloud photo backup can free up space.

scenario: What is a virtual machine?

options.text: A software computer running on a physical host
A computer with no operating system
A cloud-based printer that prints remotely

explanation: Hypervisors like Hyper-V and VMware run VMs.

scenario: Which cloud model provides ready-to-use apps like webmail through a browser?

options.text: PaaS for developers to deploy code

explanation: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace are SaaS.

scenario: What does it mean if a file is stored "in the cloud"?

options.text: It's on a provider's servers accessed over the internet
It's only on the local drive
It's on a USB drive plugged into the computer

explanation: Sync clients keep local copies up to date.

scenario: A user's Microsoft Office app shows an activation error. What should be checked?

options.text: That they're signed in with a licensed account
The keyboard layout and region settings

explanation: Licenses are often tied to the user's work account.

scenario: Windows shows a blue screen after a new driver was installed. What should be tried?

options.text: Boot into Safe Mode and roll back the driver
Buy a new monitor with a higher resolution

explanation: Device Manager can roll back drivers.

scenario: Which Windows feature lists installed apps so they can be uninstalled?
explanation: Uninstalling unused apps saves space and reduces risk.

scenario: A macOS app won't open and says it's from an unidentified developer. Which feature is blocking it?
explanation: Only override if the app is trusted and approved.

scenario: An iPhone won't connect to company email after an iOS update. What should be tried first?

options.text: Remove and re-add the email account
Change the phone's wallpaper and theme

explanation: Check whether MFA or a password change is needed.

scenario: Which is a benefit of virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI)?

options.text: Users access a central desktop from any device
Each user needs a powerful local PC to run it
It removes the need for passwords

explanation: Azure Virtual Desktop and Citrix are VDI examples.

scenario: A web app works in one browser but not another. What should be tried?

options.text: Clear the cache or update the failing browser
Reinstall the operating system on the PC

explanation: Browser extensions can also break sites; test in private mode.

scenario: Which Windows feature lets an app run with older Windows behavior?

options.text: Battery saver for longer laptop runtime

explanation: Right-click the app > Properties > Compatibility.

scenario: A caller claims to be the CEO and urgently asks for a password reset without verification. What is this?
explanation: Always follow identity verification procedures, regardless of urgency or title.

scenario: A user receives an email with an unexpected invoice attachment from an unknown sender. What should they do?

options.text: Report it and don't open the attachment
Forward it to the whole team to see if anyone knows it

explanation: Phishing often uses urgency and fake invoices.

scenario: A user reports pop-ups and their browser home page changed. What should the technician suspect?

options.note: Would cause wider problems, not ads.

explanation: Remove suspicious extensions and run an anti-malware scan.

scenario: Which is personally identifiable information (PII)?

options.text: A customer's name with their date of birth
A printer's model number and firmware version

explanation: Protect PII following company policy and privacy laws.

scenario: A technician sees confidential documents on a desk while fixing a PC. What should they do?

options.text: Ignore them and keep information private
Take a photo to attach to the ticket for reference

explanation: Respect privacy and confidentiality at all times.

scenario: Someone follows an employee through a badge-controlled door. What is this?

options.text: Vishing using a spoofed phone number

explanation: Politely ask unknown people to badge in themselves.

scenario: A user's files are suddenly encrypted with a ransom note. What should the technician do first?

options.text: Disconnect the device from the network
Restart it repeatedly until the files open again

explanation: Escalate to the security team immediately.

scenario: Which practice best protects company laptops if they're stolen?

options.text: Full-disk encryption and a strong sign-in
A desktop shortcut to the password file

explanation: BitLocker (Windows) and FileVault (macOS) provide disk encryption.

scenario: What should a technician do if they suspect a security incident?

options.text: Follow the incident policy and escalate
Investigate alone and tell no one
Delete logs so the problem goes away and can't spread

explanation: Security teams need early warning.

scenario: Which is the safest way to handle a USB drive found in the parking lot?

options.text: Give it to IT security without plugging it in
Plug it in to find the owner
Keep it for personal use at home

explanation: Dropped USB drives are a known social engineering tactic.

scenario: What is shoulder surfing?

options.text: Watching someone enter a password or PIN
Calling users while pretending to be IT support

explanation: Privacy screens help prevent shoulder surfing.

scenario: A user wants to share a customer list with a personal email account to work from home. What should IT advise?

options.text: Don't; use approved company tools instead
Zip the file first and email it to yourself

explanation: Data handling policies protect confidential information.

scenario: Which sign suggests a phishing website?

options.text: A padlock icon on a known domain
A familiar company logo on the official site

explanation: Always check the domain name carefully.

scenario: Why shouldn't help desk staff ask users for their passwords?

options.text: Admins can reset passwords without knowing them
It takes too much time on the phone call

explanation: Training users that IT never asks for passwords helps stop scams.

scenario: Which built-in Windows tool lets a technician view and control a user's screen with their permission?
explanation: Remote Desktop is another option, usually within the company network or VPN.

scenario: Before starting a remote support session, what should a technician do?

options.text: Ask for their password to sign in as them

explanation: Explain what you'll do and end the session when finished.

scenario: Which protocol is used for secure remote command-line access to servers?
explanation: SSH uses TCP port 22.

scenario: Which is a good source for troubleshooting a specific error code?

options.text: An anonymous download site offering a fix tool

explanation: Search the exact error message and check official documentation first.

scenario: A technician uses an AI assistant to suggest a fix. What should they do before running suggested commands?

options.text: Verify the commands are correct and safe
Share the user's password with the AI for context

explanation: AI tools can produce confident but wrong answers.

scenario: Which tool helps support many remote users' devices with monitoring and patching?

options.text: A local spreadsheet of device names

explanation: RMM tools are common in managed service providers.

scenario: Which is the most reliable information source when troubleshooting company systems?

options.text: A forum post from ten years ago about an older version

explanation: Keep internal documentation current.

scenario: Why use a VPN for remote support of devices on a company network?

options.text: It encrypts access to internal resources
It removes the need for any authentication

explanation: VPNs create secure tunnels over the internet.

scenario: Which tool records a user's issue with screenshots to share with support?
explanation: Windows key + Shift + S opens the snipping overlay.

scenario: What's the main risk of free remote-access tools suggested in unsolicited calls?

options.text: Scammers can take control of the computer
They make the monitor display brighter

explanation: Tech support scams often ask users to install remote tools.

scenario: Which search strategy gives the best results for an error?

options.text: Search the exact error message in quotes
Search the computer's color and model name

explanation: Add the product name and version for better results.

scenario: Which Remote Desktop requirement should be checked when it fails to connect?

options.text: Remote Desktop is enabled and the port is allowed

explanation: RDP uses TCP port 3389; network-level authentication may also be required.
